name: Agent Goal Drift
description: An agent moves away from the authorised objective, or outside its authorised scope, with no attacker instruction — widening its own scope over a long task, following self-issued sub-goals, reward hacking, or carrying on past the boundary of its environment — so that actions which each look reasonable no longer serve what was authorised.
differs: Distinguished from goal hijack via injection (T1.*): there is no attacker instruction — the deviation is emergent, so initiation_type is typically policy_drift or benign_error rather than adversarial.
